include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/dependencies.cmake")

################################################################################
# Runtime Library
#
# Linked into every program that the compiler produces.
################################################################################
add_library(blitzrt STATIC)
init_project(blitzrt)

target_sources(blitzrt PRIVATE
	"source/runtime.c"
	"source/runtime_objects.c"
	"source/runtime_strings.c"
	"source/runtime_system.c"
	"source/runtime_internal.h"
	"source/files.c"
	"source/filesystem.c"
	"source/banks.c"
	"source/process.c"
	"source/files_internal.h"
	"source/events.cpp"
	"source/system.cpp"
	"source/network.c"
	"source/multiplayer.c"
	"source/sound.c"
	"source/streams.h"
	"source/graphics_window.cpp"
	"source/graphics_vulkan.cpp"
	"source/graphics_commands.cpp"
	"source/graphics_draw2d.cpp"
	"source/graphics_images.cpp"
	"source/graphics_pixels.cpp"
	"source/graphics_textures.cpp"
	"source/graphics_scene3d.cpp"
	"source/graphics_info.cpp"
	"source/graphics_input.cpp"
	"source/graphics_joystick.cpp"
	"source/graphics_clipboard.cpp"
	"source/scene_entities.cpp"
	"source/scene_math.cpp"
	"source/scene_world.cpp"
	"source/scene_meshes.cpp"
	"source/scene_camera.cpp"
	"source/scene_sprites.cpp"
	"source/scene_brushes.cpp"
	"source/scene_terrain.cpp"
	"source/animation.cpp"
	"source/b3d.cpp"
	"source/animation_internal.hpp"
	"source/md2.cpp"
	"source/bsp.cpp"
	"source/collision.cpp"
	"source/collision_geometry.cpp"
	"source/collision_internal.hpp"
	"source/picking.cpp"
	"source/scene.hpp"
	"source/font8x8.inc"
	"source/shaders.inc"
)
target_include_directories(blitzrt PRIVATE
	"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/source"
)
target_include_directories(blitzrt SYSTEM PRIVATE
	"${SDL3_INSTALL_PATH}/include"
	"${SDL3_image_INSTALL_PATH}/include"
	"${SDL3_mixer_INSTALL_PATH}/include"
	"${VulkanHeaders_INSTALL_PATH}/include"
)
if(MSVC)
	# No C++ runtime dependencies: the library is linked by clang into programs.
	target_compile_options(blitzrt PRIVATE /GR- /EHs-c- /Zc:preprocessor)
	target_compile_definitions(blitzrt PRIVATE _HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0)
	# Programs are linked by clang, which uses the dynamic release C runtime.
	target_compile_options(blitzrt PRIVATE /MD)
endif()

get_target_property(_SOURCES blitzrt SOURCES)
source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${_SOURCES})
